verdict.rationale: The only scheduling-like capability in the evidence is a configurable recurring deposit frequency for active merchants, set via the Update merchant endpoint. Workflow automation is otherwise event-driven, either through webhooks or the third-party Zapier no-code integration, which needs an extra tool. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows, documented recurring/scheduled payments, a native workflow scheduler, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
